H6846G.name: Zephaniah
H6846G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6846G.brief: Priest during the reign of Zedekiah
H6846G.short: Zephaniah, a priest during King Zedekiah's reign, was taken captive to Babylon.

H6846I.name: Zephaniah
H6846I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6846I.brief: One of the men in Zechariah's prophecy
H6846I.short: Zephaniah was one of the men in whose crown was to be placed in the temple as a memorial.

H6846H.name: Zephaniah
H6846H.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6846H.brief: Prophet, son of Cushi, descendant of Hezekiah
H6846H.short: Zephaniah, the prophet who wrote the book bearing his name, was the son of Cushi and descendant of Hezekiah.

H6825.name: Zepho
H6825.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6825.brief: Son of Eliphaz, grandson of Esau
H6825.short: Zepho, a son of Eliphaz and grandson of Esau, was a chief of Edom.

H6889.name: Zereth
H6889.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6889.brief: Son of Ashhur, founder of Tekoa
H6889.short: Zereth, a son of Ashhur (or 'Ashur') and Helah, was a Judahite.

H6874.name: Zeri
H6874.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H6874.brief: Son of Jeduthun, a temple musician
H6874.short: Zeri (or Izri), a son of Jeduthun, was a temple musician during the reign of David.

H6872C.name: Zeror
H6872C.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H6872C.short: Zeror, a Benjamite, was an ancestor of King Saul.

H6871.name: Zeruah
H6871.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H6871.brief: Mother of Jeroboam, first king of Israel
H6871.short: Zeruah was the mother of Jeroboam, who became the first king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

H6870G.name: Zeruiah
H6870G.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H6870G.brief: Sister of David; mother of Joab, Abishai, and Asahel
H6870G.short: Zeruiah, David's sister, was the mother of Joab, Abishai, and Asahel, who were among David's mighty men and military leaders.

H6837.name: Ziphion
H6837.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6837.brief: Son of Gad, progenitor of the Zephonites
H6837.short: Ziphion (or Zephon), a son of Gad, was the ancestor of the Zephonite clan.

H6834.name: Zippor
H6834.desc: Moabite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6834.brief: Father of Balak, king of Moab
H6834.short: Zippor was the father of Balak, the king of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

H6855.name: Zipporah
H6855.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6855.brief: Wife of Moses, daughter of Jethro
H6855.short: Zipporah, the daughter of Jethro, was Moses' wife and the mother of his two sons, Gershom and Eliezer.

H6882.name: Zorathites
H6882.short: The Zorathites were a Judahite clan descended from Shobal.

H6865.name: Tyre
H6865.brief: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade
H6865.short: Tyre, a prominent Phoenician port city, known for its wealth, trade, and craftsmanship, often mentioned in the context of judgment and prophecy (<ref="Josh. 19:29; 2Sam. 5:11; 1Kgs. 5:1; Isa. 23:1-17; Ezek. 26-28; Matt. 11:21-22; Act.12.20">Josh. 19:29; 2Sam. 5:11; 1Kgs. 5:1; Isa. 23:1-17; Ezek. 26-28; Matt. 11:21-22; Act.12.20</ref>).

H6815.name: Zaanannim
H6815.brief: A place near Kedesh in Naphtali
H6815.short: Zaanannim, a place near Kedesh in Naphtali, associated with the Kenites and mentioned in connection with the story of Deborah and Barak (<ref="Josh. 19:33; Judg. 4:11">Josh. 19:33; Judg. 4:11</ref>).

H6829.name: Zaphon
H6829.brief: A city in Gad and a term for the north
H6829.short: Zaphon, a city allotted to the tribe of Gad, also used as a term for the north or the heavenly dwelling place of God (<ref="Josh. 13:27; Judg. 12:1; Ps. 48:2; Isa. 14:13">Josh. 13:27; Judg. 12:1; Ps. 48:2; Isa. 14:13</ref>).

H6886.name: Zarephath
H6886.brief: A Phoenician city where Elijah stayed with a widow
H6886.short: Zarephath, a Phoenician city between Tyre and Sidon, where Elijah stayed with a widow during a famine and performed miracles (<ref="1Kgs. 17:9-10; Obad. 1:20; Luke 4:26">1Kgs. 17:9-10; Obad. 1:20; Luke 4:26</ref>).

H6891.name: Zarethan
H6891.brief: A place near the Jordan River associated with Israel's crossing
H6891.short: Zarethan, a place near Adam and the Jordan River, mentioned in connection with Israel's crossing and the casting of bronze implements for Solomon's Temple (<ref="Josh. 3:16; 1Kgs. 4:12; 7:46; 2Chr. 4:17; Judg. 7:22">Josh. 3:16; 1Kgs. 4:12; 7:46; 2Chr. 4:17; Judg. 7:22</ref>).

H6857.name: Zephath
H6857.brief: A Canaanite city captured by Judah and Simeon
H6857.short: Zephath, later called Hormah, was a Canaanite city that Israel failed to capture but was later defeated by Judah and Simeon .

H6859.name: Zephathah Valley
H6859.brief: A valley where Asa defeated the Cushite army
H6859.short: The Valley of Zephathah is where King Asa of Judah defeated Zerah the Cushite's large army .

H6863.name: Zer
H6863.short: Zer was a fortified city in the territory of Naphtali .

H6868G.name: Zeredah
H6868G.brief: The hometown of Jeroboam, first king of Israel
H6868G.short: Zeredah was the hometown of Jeroboam, who became the first king of the northern kingdom of Israel .

H6890.name: Zereth-shahar
H6890.brief: A city in Reuben's territory by the Dead Sea
H6890.short: Zereth-shahar was a city in the territory of Reuben, located on a mountain in the plain by the Dead Sea .

H6860.name: Ziklag
H6860.brief: A city given to David; originally Judah's, then Simeon's
H6860.short: Ziklag was a city allotted to Judah and Simeon that was later given to David by the Philistine king Achish .

H6814.name: Zoan
H6814.brief: An ancient Egyptian city, probably Tanis
H6814.short: Zoan was an ancient Egyptian city where God performed miracles through Moses; it is probably to be identified with Tanis .

H6820.name: Zoar
H6820.brief: A city near Sodom, spared from destruction
H6820.short: Zoar, also known as Bela, was a small city near Sodom where Lot fled when God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah .

H6839.name: Zophim
H6839.brief: A place in Moab where Balaam blessed Israel
H6839.short: The field of Zophim was a place on the top of Pisgah in Moab where Balaam blessed Israel .

H6881.name: Zorah
H6881.brief: A town in the Shephelah, home of Samson
H6881.short: Zorah was a town in the Shephelah region, originally allotted to Judah and later to Dan, and was the hometown of Samson .
